moments.title: Community Shield Showdown
moments.blurb: The traditional curtain-raiser for the English football season, the FA Community Shield, takes place on Sunday, August 16, 2026, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal against FA Cup holders Manchester City at Cardiff's Principality Stadium.

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: Arsenal vs Man City for the first silverware of the season! Who's lifting the Community Shield next Sunday? #CommunityShield

angles.name: Local Buzz
angles.copy: Cardiff takes centre stage! The Principality Stadium hosts Arsenal v Man City for the Community Shield next weekend. Are you ready, Wales?
